normalization.technique_method: ordered family-specific semantic rules over normalized category + name + description + technique; family is an attribute, never the technique signature
caution_boundaries: film-burn/light-leak not merged with plain cross-dissolve

thresholds.justification: 26 techniques occupy the mandated unique peak at max 1–2; 15 form the 3–4 shoulder; repeated-use cluster starts at 5. N=5 separates many from occasional while preserving gray. M=2 is the literal cross-video condition.
